host_auth_create.title: Sign in to Maple
host_auth_create.description: Signs you in or out of Maple.

host_auth_get.title: Check your Maple sign-in
host_auth_get.description: Reads whether you are signed in to Maple.

host_proof_list.title: Read Maple's own records
host_proof_list.description: Reads Maple's internal record of what happened in this workspace.

host_demo_reset_create.title: Start Maple over
host_demo_reset_create.description: Erases everything in this Maple workspace and starts it fresh. This cannot be undone.

host_voice_create.title: Start talking to Maple
host_voice_create.description: Starts a voice session so you can talk to Maple instead of typing.

host_transferMoney.title: Send money
host_transferMoney.description: Send money from the user's checking account. This IRREVERSIBLY MOVES MONEY: it debits checking and appends a posted transfer. There is no undo.

host_createOrder.title: Place an order
host_createOrder.description: Place a delivery order on the user's account. This MOVES MONEY: it charges the user's card and appends a transaction.
